overview: A transaction row people can select: a checkbox to choose several items or a radio to choose one, such as the receivables to advance.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.text: Default. Pass `checked`, `onChange`, `indeterminate`, `error` and `id` in `checkbox`. The whole row is the label of the control.

radio.title: Radio
radio.text: Pass `radio` instead of `checkbox` to choose one item. Use the same `name` in every row of the group.

rules: Control the selection through `checkbox` or `radio`; don’t add a separate control next to the row.
Use radios only when exactly one item can be chosen, and give every radio of the group the same `name`.
Keep `platform="web"` (control on the left) on the web and `platform="app"` (control on the right) in apps.
Pass amounts formatted and without a sign; `amount.type` adds the sign and the color.
Place rows inside `List` and set `showDivider={false}` on the last row.

api.radio: Radio control. Replaces the checkbox when set. Use the same `name` in the group.
api.platform: Side of the control: `web` on the left, `app` on the right.
